key.name: size
key.description: Playing field size. 1=Small, 2=Medium, 3=Large. Any other value is invalid.

key.name: difficulty
key.description: Game difficulty level. Determines how many pieces are added each round. Valid values: 'easy', 'normal', 'hard'.

key.name: ball-theme
key.description: Ball style. The filename of the images to use for the balls.

key.name: background-color
key.description: Background color. The hex specification of the background color.

key.name: score
key.description: Game score from last saved session.

key.name: field
key.description: Game field from last saved session.

key.name: preview
key.description: Game preview from last saved session.

key.name: window-width
key.summary: Width of the window in pixels

key.name: window-height
key.summary: Height of the window in pixels

key.name: window-is-maximized
key.summary: true if the window is maximized

key.name: enable-composite-lines
key.description: Enable combo play mode that allows gap-separated patterns (like 2+3, 3+2) to count as valid lines. When disabled, only continuous lines count (traditional Five-or-More rules).

key.name: enable-development-tab
key.description: Enable the development tab in the sidebar panel. This tab contains debugging information and is primarily intended for developers.

key.name: sidebar-active-tab
key.description: The currently active tab in the sidebar panel. 0 = Statistics, 1 = Development (if enabled).
